desc: Initialize a 2D DP array `dp[n+1][n+1]` with infinity, `dp[0][0] = 0`.
Iterate `j` from 1 to `n` (number of subarrays), and `i` from `j` to `n` (prefix length).
For each `dp[i][j]`, iterate `l` from `j-1` to `i-1` to find the best previous cut.
Calculate the cost of the `j`-th subarray `nums[l..i-1]` and update `dp[i][j]`.
The answer is `min(dp[n][j])` for all `j` from 1 to `n`.
